zh: 历史懒渲染保留宿主折叠语义：收起后隐藏思考、工具和中间说明，最终答案继续可见，展开及浏览器查找保持可用。工作室首页卡片、对话图片、Mermaid、SVG 和生成式组件居中，正文保持原有阅读方向。
en: Lazy history rendering preserves native folds: thoughts, tools and intermediate notes stay hidden while the final answer remains visible; reopening and browser find continue to work. Centre the studio dashboard, conversation images, Mermaid, SVG and generated components while preserving prose alignment.
